column1: # Orthographic variants (異體字): different glyphs for the same character, not different readings.
# Each line lists interchangeable forms, separated by spaces; a tab may follow with a note.
# Reviewed by hand against the collation. Pairs that are real textual variants
# (e.g. 己/已, 苞/包, 祗/祇, 洌/冽, 厤/歷) are deliberately NOT listed here.

column2: the Song print does not distinguish 已 and 巳
